description: List the messages of a chat (chatId, cht_...) or a device (deviceId, dev_...), newest first. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for older messages, or a message id (msg_...) as sinceId to get newer ones oldest first.

chatId.description: Chat public id (cht_...); list its messages

deviceId.description: Device public id (dev_...); list its messages across chats

sinceId.description: Message public id (msg_...); return newer messages, oldest first

name: message_list
title: Message list
